title: With the grid off, only the grid switch is on the tool bar
goal: Switching the grid off leaves its size button, its divider and its adjust button sitting on the tool bar doing nothing for a grid that is not there. Only the switch should remain, so the bar carries what is in use and nothing else. Switching the grid back on brings the rest back.
notes: Asked for by the user on 2026-09-07. Today the whole group is drawn whenever the feature is on and a document is open: EditorView.gridChip (line 670) reads isVisible only to light the switch, and the size button, divider and gear are built unconditionally below it. So the fix is to branch inside that view rather than to add a new one. Two details to get right: the size button already opens a popover and the gear enters a mode, so make sure neither can be left open or entered as the grid is switched off, and that leaving grid adjustment with the grid off does not leave a stranded bar. EditorChromeLayout.showsGridChip decides whether the group fits at the current width, so whatever the group becomes when the grid is off has to be measured too, or a narrow window will keep reserving room for controls that are not drawn.
acceptance: With the grid off, the tool bar shows the grid switch and nothing else of the grid: no size button, no divider, no adjust button
Switching the grid on brings them back in place, and switching off and on repeatedly leaves the bar exactly as it started
The tool bar does not jump or reflow awkwardly as they come and go, and nothing beside them shifts more than the room they gave up
Everything those controls do is still reachable while the grid is off, from the menus, and the audit says where
The grid switch keeps its own look and tooltip and still says whether the grid is on
Audit written under queue/audits/ with the bar in both states, anything rough filed as a follow-up
